page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is a high-density compute-optimized instance built on x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. The server features 192 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. It is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

Networking capabilities include a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The instance contains no local SSD storage, requiring external block storage for persistent disk volumes. It also omits GPU acceleration and complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The high vCPU core density combined with a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio prioritizes parallel CPU-bound compute execution over memory-heavy caching.

From a resource design standpoint, the instance offers high compute core density within a single node. This resource profile fits large-scale multi-threaded workloads, batch processing, high-performance computing, financial modeling, and distributed build systems where CPU execution capacity takes priority over large memory footprints or onboard local storage.

It pairs these processing cores with 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding 2.0 GB of memory per vCPU. The instance provides 64 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth but includes no local storage or onboard GPU acceleration, relying on network-attached storage for disk operations. This hardware design maximizes parallel processing core density per node without over-allocating system memory. Consequently, ecs.c8a.48xlarge is suited for compute-heavy workloads such as distributed software builds, batch data processing, high-performance computing, video rendering, and parallel simulation tasks where CPU throughput is required.
